avg_daily_change_90d.method: straight line: (last close − first close) / calendar days in the 90-day window. Not the least-squares rate the clock uses.

per_second_rate_method: 90-day least-squares trend of Debt to the Penny

clock_daily_change_90d.method: 90-day least-squares slope of Debt to the Penny × 86,400. This is the live clock. per_second_rate is that slope rounded to the cent. avg_daily_change_90d is the straight line between the window's end points, not this slope.

per_person_basis: _official = Treasury close / official Census estimate (no projection); _projected_now = projected debt / population projected at Census's stated rate. Pages quote _official.
displayed_per_person_note: The figure the site displays. Treasury close divided by the official Census estimate. debt_per_person_projected_now divides a debt projection by a population projection and is not shown as debt per person.

days_to_limit_estimate.method: Estimate, not a Treasury forecast. Headroom (statutory limit minus debt subject to the limit) divided by the 90-day least-squares daily change in debt subject to the limit, from Daily Treasury Statement Table III-C. Debt does not rise in a straight line. This ignores the Treasury cash balance, tax season, and extraordinary measures, so it is not an X-date.
